title: Recursive Accelerating Return: A Generative Collapse Dynamics Theory of Endogenous Generative Capacity
object_of_study: A collapse-return recurrence in which admitted returned structure changes the next productive generator and the resulting effective productive rate may accelerate, decelerate, saturate, reverse, or fail.
main_question: What must be inherited, what counts as admissible return, and what rate must increase before a recursive acceleration claim is earned?

claim_layers.claim: RAR is formulated as a derived regime of GCD and does not redefine the Tier-1 UMCP kernel (source-stated publication status).

Operational classification requires admissible return, an identified endogenous operator change, a positive identified effect of that change on later productive capacity, a positive increasing effective log-capacity rate across the declared observation window, and frozen persistence/uncertainty/resource-accounting conditions (GCD.RAR.CORE).
The classification does not by itself establish that inheritance caused the rate increase; a causal-RAR claim requires an additional longitudinal counterfactual.
Evidence boundary: formal theory, synthetic operational demonstrations, and a prospective falsification design; no empirical validation of RAR is claimed.
The source's conditional claim: trajectories satisfying the stated conditions belong to a RAR solution class of GCD; this is not a forecast of inevitable acceleration.
The library places this as candidate-class theory under RCFT (exploration before freeze) with a diagnostic secondary role.

scope: Formal statement of Recursive Accelerating Return as a derived GCD regime: cycle boundary, admissible return, endogenous operator recursion, effective generative return rate r_n = a_n / Δt_n, the GCD.RAR.CORE study-level contract, the GCD.RAR.MAP.<domain> mapping requirement, synthetic demonstrations, and a prospective test domain.
exclusions: Does not redefine the Tier-1 kernel.
Does not claim empirical validation of RAR.
Does not claim that all complex systems accelerate or that technological acceleration is inevitable.
Does not by itself establish that inheritance caused an observed rate increase.
preserved_meaning: The source's separation of generative capacity, per-cycle log-gain, and inter-return interval, and its conditional (not forecasting) character.
